description: Fetch the raw HTML of a public homepage and extract the page title without authentication.
nl_goal: I am building an uptime and SEO monitoring dashboard. Please fetch the homepage of the official Python website ('https://www.python.org/') and extract the text inside the HTML <title> tag. Print the title.

paradigm_3_config.skill_description: A standard tool to fetch a webpage's HTML and extract its title tag for monitoring purposes.
